# Warm Up

Open the following shinyapps and explore a little bit. 

+ [Data Wrangling](https://psu-eberly.shinyapps.io/data_wrangling/)
+ [Biodiversity in NPS](https://abenedetti.shinyapps.io/bioNPS/)
+ [Hex Memory Game](https://dreamrs.shinyapps.io/memory-hex/)
+ [Lake Profile Dashboard](https://gallery.shinyapps.io/lake-profile-dashboard/)
+ [Classification Trees](https://asluby.shinyapps.io/GSS_classification/)

With the folks around you, discuss: 

1. Did any apps stand out as enjoyable or useful? 
2. What features or design choices make an app stand out? 
3. Are there any small tweaks you could make to make them more usable?

# The manager survey app

Start from your `v4` app (inputs in a sidebar, outputs on tabs), or use [`v4-layout/app.R`](https://github.com/stat220-f26/stat220-f26.github.io/blob/main/files/apps/v4-layout/app.R). 

## Part 1: Theme

- Add a theme: `fluidPage(theme = bslib::bs_theme(bootswatch = "flatly"), ...)`
- Try `bslib::bs_themer()` in your server function to find colors and fonts that you like (remove it when you're done)
- Add `thematic::thematic_shiny()` near the top of `app.R` so the plots match
- Check the contrast and the font sizes. Could someone with low vision read your app?

::: callout-warning
## Package version

`thematic_shiny()` needs `{thematic}` 0.1.8 or newer. If the app fails to start with an error about `ggplot_build.ggplot`, run `install.packages("thematic")`.
:::

## Part 2: Project structure

- Create a new folder for your app, and put a copy of `app.R` in it
- Move the data preparation (`select()`, `filter()`) into a script called `data-prep.R`
- Write the cleaned data to `data/manager-survey.rds` with `write_rds()`, and read it in `app.R` with `read_rds("data/manager-survey.rds")`

::: callout-important
Use a **relative** path: `"data/manager-survey.rds"`. A path that starts with `/` points at the root of your computer.
:::

## Part 3: Deploy

- Click the blue **Publish** button at the top right of `app.R` and choose posit connect cloud (if you haven't connected your account yet, follow the ["Deploy from RStudio"](https://docs.posit.co/connect-cloud/how-to/r/shiny-r.html#deploy-from-rstudio) instructions)
- Make sure that `app.R` **and** `data/manager-survey.rds` are ticked in the list of files
- When it finishes, open the URL in a private window and test every input and tab
- Add the URL to your README

::: callout-tip
## If it fails

Read the deployment log from the bottom up. The usual causes are a missing data file, a wrong path, or a `library()` call that is missing from `app.R`.
:::
